tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po la bskang bshags 'phrin bcol mdor bsdus srid zhi'i yon tan mthar phyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka tsa turmu kha ya/ hūm̐ stobs 'phrog dbang po yum chen bzhi/ /dregs pa bcu bzhi sgo bdud dang / /rol bshan nyer gcig la sogs pa/ /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin tshogs/ /rtag rten rgyun gyi gtor ma sogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul dpag med kyis/ /lha mchog nag po'i thugs dam bskang / /lha chen zhal bzhi'i thugs dam bskang / /gzi ldan dbang phyug༞ /bram ze'i gzugs can༞ /yum chen sring bzhi'i༞ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang / /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /sgo gsum nyes ltung ma lus bshags/ /bskang gyur dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin rab rgyas shing / /'jig rten bde skyid dar bar mdzod/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos dang / /mgon po khyed kyis zhal bzhes ltar/ /sa skya'i rje btsun chos srid kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan pa dang / 'chi med 'khon rigs sa skya'i gdung / /myur du 'byon zhing 'gal rkyen zhi/ /sku tshe mdzad 'phrin mthar phyin nas/ /skye dgu kun gyis mgon gyur mdzod/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad srungs/ /bsam pa'i don kun chos bzhin sgrubs/ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor dbang du bsdus/ /dgra bgegs log 'dren rdul du rlog /deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /lha mchog khyed las skyabs gzhan med/ /de phyir thugs rjes nyer dgongs la/ /srid zhi'i yon tan mthar phyin mdzod/ /ces stobs 'phrog dbang po la bskang bshags 'phrin bcol mdor bsdus srid zhi'i yon tan mthar phyin 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos dgos gal che nges zhig mthong nas phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer gyi bgyis pa dge/
